title: Goldreich–Levin stage records for a target
statement: Let the input consist of a dimension $n>0$, positive accuracy numerator and denominator $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. Given $k<n$ and a finite active family of coordinate subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, form the stage records as in the answer-based construction, using as each query answer the value of $f$ at the corresponding restricted-weight query point.
hypotheses_covered: finite active family of coordinate subsets
